Privacy Policy - Sunrise Matrimony

Sunrise Matrimony is a matchmaking service. We take the protection of your personal information seriously.

Information we collect
We collect your name, age, photographs, family details, education, occupation and contact information when you create a profile.

Use of information
We use this information to display your profile to other members, suggest matches and send you notifications. We may use it for marketing with your permission.

Security
We follow reasonable security practices and procedures as required by the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.

Disclosure
We do not sell your information. We may disclose it to government agencies when required by law.
